text:
Maya: Quick poll — we need a cute name for the new office coffee/ordering Slack bot. Throw votes or name ideas! ☕️
Jules: Love this. Options: Brewster, JavaJack, BeanShine, CaffBot?
Maya: Yup, vote with emoji: :one: Brewster, :two: JavaJack, :three: BeanShine, :four: CaffBot. Or propose something new.
ops-bot: Poll created: 1) Brewster 2) JavaJack 3) BeanShine 4) CaffBot — react to vote! (I will tally in 1h)
Ravi: :two: JavaJack from me. Makes me laugh every time.
Lina: :three: BeanShine — it feels wholesome.
Sam: :one: Brewster — very snappy.
Jules: +1 for Brewster.
Maya: Also open to pure puns: "LatteLarry" or "Espress-help"?
Ravi: LatteLarry is dangerously good.
Lina: Espress-help is a mood.
Sam: We should avoid anything too dad-jokey (also admitting I'm voting for Brewster).
ops-bot: Quick tally so far — Brewster: 2, JavaJack: 1, BeanShine: 1, CaffBot: 0. Still taking suggestions.
Maya: Fun idea: if we pick JavaJack he gets a little avatar of a coffee cup. If BeanShine we rotate plant emojis.
Jules: I nominate a tie-breaker rule: whoever buys coffee for the team gets naming rights. :stuck_out_tongue:
Lina: Oof — high stakes.
Sam: I'll buy if Brewster wins.
Ravi: Deal. If JavaJack wins I'll bring pastries.
Maya: OK closing in 1 hour. Thanks for the votes! :coffee:
ops-bot: Poll closed. Final tally: Brewster 3, JavaJack 2, BeanShine 1, CaffBot 0. Winner: Brewster.
Maya: Brewster it is. Sam — you committed to buy if it wins. Expect a ping. :grimacing:
Sam: Noted. Will put in an order for bagels tomorrow morning.
Jules: Love it. New bot handle: @brewster soon™ :tada:
